answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The marble holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
